title: Left-acyclic objects in short exact sequences
statement: Let $\mathcal A,\mathcal B$ be abelian categories [def-sp-abelian], where $\mathcal A$ has enough projectives: every object is a quotient of an object $P$ such that every map $P\to Y$ lifts across every epimorphism $X\to Y$. Let $V:\mathcal A\to\mathcal B$ be additive and right exact (preserving cokernels and finite direct sums). Write $Q$ for localization of the homotopy category of integer cochain complexes at quasi-isomorphisms [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Assume the total left derived functor $LV:D(\mathcal A)\to D(\mathcal B)$ is defined at every object in the essentially-constant denominator-diagram sense of Situation 05S8 and Definition 05S9 [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization], with its canonical natural comparison $\varepsilon_C:LV(QC)\to Q(V(C))$. Call $M\in\mathcal A$ left $V$-acyclic if $\varepsilon_{M[0]}:LV(Q(M[0]))\to Q(V(M)[0])$ is an isomorphism, where $M[0]$ is the complex concentrated in degree zero. For every short exact sequence $0\to M'\xrightarrow{i}M\xrightarrow{p}M''\to0$ in $\mathcal A$: (1) if $M'$ and $M''$ are left $V$-acyclic, then $M$ is left $V$-acyclic and $0\to V(M')\xrightarrow{V(i)}V(M)\xrightarrow{V(p)}V(M'')\to0$ is short exact; (2) if $M$ and $M''$ are left $V$-acyclic, then $M'$ is left $V$-acyclic and that same image sequence is short exact.

source.place: Dual of Tag 015D, lemma-F-acyclic-ses, clauses (1) and (2). The total comparison is interpreted as in Tags 05S8 and 05S9; Tag 015C, lemma-F-acyclic, identifies object acyclicity with the degree-zero comparison and higher vanishing.

Auxiliary input: Local complete-intersection determinant adjunction underlying the marked dualizing construction, before the marking is inserted. Supporting ring/sheaf input: Transitivity triangle for ring cotangent complexes. Proof of the supporting transitivity triangle: polynomial differential sequence, derived category homology comparisons, and identification of functoriality maps. Generic homological input to the category bar resolution: Bounded above acyclic complexes compute a left derived functor.
